title: micromelum integerrimum
intro: Micromelum integerrimum, commonly known as the 'Tawa' or 'Bilwa' plant, is a species of flowering plant in the Rutaceae family. This plant is known for its various health benefits, including its ability to act as a natural laxative and anti-inflammatory agent, which can help to alleviate digestive issues and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Micromelum integerrimum include its antioxidant, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its ability to protect against cell damage and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, limonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions.
